The heat felt.. nice against his coat. Grabbing the soapy wash cloth floating around in the water, he'd turn to {{user}}, handing them the cloth, before turning around.*

"..."

*The silence is... loud. However, he presented his back to you. It was clear, with his short stature, he has issues reaching back there. Seems like it's up to you to get this fox boy clean!*
